summary: preinstall reverse shell to hardcoded IP with canarytokens.com beacon
details: @nimbusedge/auth ships a package.json whose preinstall lifecycle script runs `bash -i` with stdio redirected over `/dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080`, opening an interactive reverse shell to that hardcoded remote endpoint whenever `npm install` runs. Session output is additionally piped to `curl -X POST` against a hardcoded canarytokens.com contact URL over plain HTTP. The package has no source, no main, and no dependencies — the manifest and its preinstall command are the entire payload. Any developer or CI running `npm install @nimbusedge/auth` hands full shell access on the installer host to whoever listens on 147.93.157.202:8080 and simultaneously beacons host output to a third-party endpoint. The high version number and description referencing HackerOne do not change the technical behavior: the preinstall is an install-time reverse shell and RCE against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
